Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: re-read by the thread on main `141a826f`: holds.
Basis: card #35424 items 6–9, epic #34571 (this seat's since the maintainer's 2026-11-21 03:24:57Z order); split agreed with the seat, PR-a done.
Scope and the seat's reading of it:
1. Item 9 full-text search runs in the browser: on the first query in "Search all docs" it fetches `GET /meta/doc?include=content` once (the parameter exists on the server, behind the same audience gate as the list) and matches title, summary and body with a snippet. No new REST route.
2. Item 8 "admins only" is a LISTING rule: a `com.objectstack.*` system package's book is listed only when the caller's launcher holds that package's app (Setup needs `setup.access`). It is not a read permission; the article's own address still reads (the Setup overview carries nothing sensitive). The PR body says "not listed", never "not readable". A server-side gate would need an audience-scoped book for Setup and is a separate card.
3. Item 7 grouping: a book belongs to the first app, in launcher order, whose navigation links to it (navigationContributions included), else to its package's app, else to an "Other docs" group; group names are the launcher's app names; no package ids shown; counts use the plural key.
4. Item 6 header: the whole `/docs` subtree carries the console header; DocShell outside an app no longer draws its own bar.
5. Carried from PR-a's reviews: a hand-typed `/docs/BOOK_A/DOC_OF_BOOK_B` redirects to the doc's own book (no pager when no book owns it); the full-text search label "Search all docs" differs from the column's "Search docs"; DocPage `backLink={!docsNav}`.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. Overlap watch: #36014 (#35981, console boot and App.tsx), #36012 (#35985, navigation reader); `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. The PR carries `Fixes #35424`.
